description: A tiny msgvault-shaped mailbox: real In-Reply-To/References chains, quoted replies, varied dates and multiple participants. Deliberately unlike the flat, one-message-per-document TREC legal collection, so it exercises the threading behaviour that corpus cannot reach.

messages.subject: Warehouse lease renewal - terms for 2027
messages.body:
Priya,

The Dock Street warehouse lease expires in March 2027. The landlord has proposed a 9% uplift and a five-year term with no break clause.

Can we discuss before the board pack goes out?

Dana

messages.subject: Re: Warehouse lease renewal - terms for 2027
messages.body:
A 9% uplift is above the index. I would counter at 4% and insist on a break at year three.

Adding Marcus for the finance view.

Priya

On 12 Jan 2026, Dana wrote:

> proposed a 9% uplift and a five-year term with no break clause.

messages.subject: Re: Warehouse lease renewal - terms for 2027
messages.body:
Finance can support 4%. Anything above 6% breaches the facilities budget envelope.
